name: Perform Gene Expression Nmf Analysis
description: Performs Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) on gene expression data to extract metagenes and their associated sample weights for tumor subtype identification.
detailed_description: Performs Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) on gene expression data to extract metagenes and their associated sample weights for tumor subtype identification.
when_to_use: When you need perform gene expression nmf analysis analysis

parameters.expression_data_path: [Required] Path to a CSV or TSV file containing gene expression data with genes as rows and samples as columns. Values should be non-negative. (str)
parameters.normalize: [Optional] Whether to normalize the expression data before applying NMF. (default: True)
parameters.output_dir: [Optional] Directory to save the output files. (default: nmf_results)
